PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>

  VALUES ?film {
    dbr:Tenth_Avenue_Angel dbr:Brink_of_Life
  }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .

}
ORDER BY DESC(?deathDate)
LIMIT 1
